name: Lady – Glam Gown
subtitle: Luxury ballroom, sequinned evening gown
prompt: Transform this photo into a luxury editorial portrait. Place the person(s) in an elegant art-deco ballroom with crystal chandeliers, gold detailing and soft warm lighting. Dress each woman in a glamorous floor-length sequinned evening gown in champagne gold. Full-body or three-quarter framing, fashion magazine quality, sharp focus, photorealistic.

name: Baju Melayu Raya
subtitle: Festive Hari Raya portrait, traditional attire
prompt: Transform this photo into a festive Hari Raya portrait. Dress the men in a well-fitted Baju Melayu with samping and songkok, and the women in an elegant Baju Kurung with matching colours in emerald green and gold. Background: a decorated traditional Malay kampung house veranda with pelita lights and ketupat decorations, warm golden-hour light. Photorealistic, family portrait style.

name: Corporate Headshot
subtitle: Clean studio portrait for LinkedIn
prompt: Transform this photo into a professional corporate studio portrait. Dress each person in smart business attire (dark blazer, neat shirt or blouse). Plain soft grey studio backdrop, professional three-point lighting, shallow depth of field, head-and-shoulders framing, photorealistic, high-end corporate photography.
